name: Högarps kulturreservat - Lemnhult
description: Högarps kulturreservat to Lemnhult. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Current official HÖ7 is Högarps kulturreservat - Lemnhult, 21.7 km. Legacy sources describe Etapp 3:5 Stenberga - Lemnhult at about 16-16.3 km, starting about 4 km from the current HÖ7 start and not matching current sectioning.
The HÖ7 nearby list did not expose Lemnhult ledentré, but HÖ8/API has Lemnhult, ledentré HÖ7/HÖ8 matching the HÖ7 endpoint within about 3.2 m.
Naturkartan labels the spur Helvetes Håla, while Länsstyrelsen uses Helvetets håla. The protected area is nearby/spur context, not necessarily a main-line HÖ7 overlap.
Hålebäcken grill near-water flag and Trollebo bathing water do not identify public drinking water.
Jättabacken has duplicate/overlapping toilet records around 57.28967,15.27432. Rest-cabin text mentions trash at the bottom of the hill while the grill object says no trash.
Länsstyrelsen says Smålandsleden passes through Stora och Lilla Fly, but HÖ7 GPX nearest point to its parking is about 5.2 km. This appears more relevant to HÖ8.

facilities.name: Högarp ledentré HÖ6/HÖ7
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ6/HÖ7 start entrance at Högarps kulturreservat / Högarps by. Shared HÖ6/HÖ7 endpoint. No potable-water claim.

facilities.name: Kulturreservatet Högarps by
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan cultural-reserve marker and Länsstyrelsen visitor page
facilities.description: Cultural reserve and heritage context at the HÖ7 start. Import as heritage/rule context, not camping. No water facility.

facilities.name: Högarp shelter/fire/toilet cluster
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan Högarp shelter/grill/toilet objects from HÖ6/HÖ7 official context
facilities.description: Shared Högarp shelter/fire/toilet cluster west of Högarps kulturreservat; HÖ7 text mentions the rest area, but current HÖ7 GPX does not pass it directly. Facilities lane measured the Högarp cluster about 420-701 m from the HÖ7 main route near km 0. Treat as shared HÖ6/access metadata unless backtrack facilities are supported.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Höglandsleden Hålebäcken
facilities.description: Official Hålebäcken four-person shelter at the late-stage rest cluster. Official/facility sources say users should bring their own firewood because supply is not guaranteed. No potable water.

facilities.name: Grillplats Höglandsleden Hålebäcken
facilities.description: Official fireplace at Hålebäcken. The object's near-water flag is natural water context only. No drinking-water import. Facilities lane reported no trash, grate or coal. Fire-ban dependent.

facilities.name: Raststuga Höglandsleden Jättabacken
facilities.description: Official simple rest cabin at Jättabacken with two long bunks and no fire inside; connected to the Jättabacken viewpoint/folklore context. No water. Waste metadata nearby is inconsistent and should be verified.

facilities.name: Grillplats Höglandsleden Jättabacken
facilities.description: Official Jättabacken fireplace, reported with cement ring, shelter, toilet, table and seating. No nearby water or coal. Fire-ban dependent. Waste metadata conflicts with rest-cabin text.

facilities.name: Dass Höglandsleden Jättabacken
facilities.description: Official dry toilet at/near Jättabacken. Duplicate/older toilet record also exists at about 57.289660,15.274310; import one normalized toilet.

facilities.name: Avstickare Jättabacken
facilities.description: Short spur/access marker to Jättabacken/rest cabin/viewpoint. Treat as side/access metadata rather than main HÖ7 route geometry.

facilities.name: Lemnhult ledentré HÖ7/HÖ8
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan Lemnhult ledentré marker from HÖ8/API context
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ7/HÖ8 endpoint entrance at Lemnhult. Entrance only; no official parking, toilet or water found at the ledentré.

facilities.name: Avstickare Helvetes Håla naturreservat
facilities.description: Official spur/access marker near Lemnhult for Helvetets håla naturreservat. Nearby/spur protected-area context. Do not apply reserve restrictions to the whole HÖ7 main line unless GIS overlay shows main-line entry.

facilities.name: Barmarksled Helvetets håla
facilities.description: Nearby reserve loop for Helvetets håla, off the HÖ7 main route. Nearby loop/side destination, not HÖ7 route geometry.

facilities.name: Trollebo badplats / Värnen
facilities.coordinateSource: Approximate facilities-lane candidate from Naturkartan/Vetlanda/HaV sources
facilities.description: Off-route bathing/leisure area reached by an official Höglandsleden side trail toward Trollebo badplats. Off-route via about 460 m spur. Bathing water only, not drinking water. HaV source showed latest sample 2025-06-10 suitable, no algal bloom.

facilities.name: Dass Trollebo badplats
facilities.description: Toilet at Trollebo badplats off the HÖ7 main line. Off-route via spur. Import only if spur facilities are supported.
